note: Estimates derived from the developing_marbles paradigm. The correct citation is Ciranka, S. & van den Bos, W. (2025), 'Internal uncertainty impacts social information use in risky choice across adolescence', Communications Psychology 3:137 (doi:10.1038/s44271-025-00314-6); an earlier '(2022)' attribution was incorrect. The estimates are also consistent with the broader risky-choice literature (Tymula et al. 2013; Frey et al. 2017). The original paper does not publish single-statistic baselines for the description-only condition; numbers below are reasonable expectations for adult human participants on this paradigm. Replace with on-platform empirical baselines in v2.
